preflight.note: Stamped by `repopact new`; the work item was recorded before implementation began.

acceptance_criteria.text: The two reproduced defect classes from the accepted ForgeWire case study (worktree-scan version-currency false positives; work-item README/manifest representation drift) are recorded as normal findings-register entries, mapped to existing hypotheses, with severity reflecting actual adopter impact.

A field-study synthesis section on enforcement closure is added to the findings register, explicitly labeled naturalistic/post-hoc and not a preregistered benchmark finding, and not double-counted as a normal F-0XX confirmation.

Enforcement closure (coverage/invocation/effectiveness over governed admission transitions) is added to formal-model.md as a cross-cutting admission property with a transition-level formal statement, without contradicting the checkpoint-based (non-precondition) design or the literal statement of T5.

protocol.md receives a dated 2026-08-21 amendment (appended, not rewritten) introducing a new prospective, falsifiable hypothesis (enforcement closure) motivated by but not confirmed by the naturalistic case.

benchmark-protocol.md receives a dated amendment preregistering a new comparative study for the enforcement-closure hypothesis, with arms distinguishing coverage/invocation/effectiveness failures and metrics that keep validator-reported error count separate from confirmed governance discrepancy count.

Concrete future PactBench/drift-harness scenario candidates are recorded (README/manifest mismatch mutation, two-agent id-collision S3 fixture, longitudinal zero-invocation scenario, invoked-but-ineffective scenario, unavailable-checkpoint scenario) without implementing or running any of them.

paper.md integrates the case conservatively as an endogenous longitudinal naturalistic field case (not a controlled experiment or causal proof), retaining the reflexivity/short-observation-window caveats, and does not headline the raw 269-297 reported-error count without its false-positive qualification.

Work item 032 / decision 0031 receive at most a narrow durable cross-reference to this case study as additional field motivation, with no criterion marked satisfied, no status change, and no rewrite of the chosen remote-enforcement design.
repopact validate, repopact dashboard, and repopact spec all pass cleanly on the resulting tree, with no ForgeWire file changed and no RepoPact implementation or PactBench execution performed.
